description: Source code defining the ATNConfig class and related functions for ANTLR's internal parsing engine, including constructors, equality, hashing, and string representation methods.

classes.name: ATNConfig
classes.description: Represents a configuration in the ATN used by ANTLR for parsing, including state, context, semantic info, and methods for comparison and hashing.

methods.name: NewATNConfig6
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig with specified state, alt, and context, default semantic context.

methods.name: NewATNConfig5
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig with specified state, alt, context, and semantic context.

methods.name: NewATNConfig4
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig based on an existing config and a new state.

methods.name: NewATNConfig3
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig based on an existing config, a new state, and a semantic context.

methods.name: NewATNConfig2
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig based on an existing config, a semantic context, and retains other properties.

methods.name: NewATNConfig1
methods.description: Creates a new ATNConfig based on an existing config, a new state, and a context.

methods.name: NewATNConfig
methods.description: General constructor for ATNConfig with specified properties, used internally by other constructors.

methods.name: LHash
methods.description: Computes a hash code for a lexer-specific ATNConfig.

methods.name: LEquals
methods.description: Checks equality between lexer-specific ATNConfig objects.

methods.name: PEquals
methods.description: Checks equality between parser-specific ATNConfig objects.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the ATNConfig based on its type.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ATNConfig for debugging.
